page.overview:
What is Blob?

Blob (ブロブ, Burobu) is the Stand of the 37th universe version of Dolcio Cioccolata, appearing in JORGE JOESTAR. It was mentioned that a Stand had sucked up some citizens of Morioh at a school gym, though it was not confirmed which Stand.

Blob appears similarly to Cioccalata's original universes Stand, Green Day. It has dark skin with lines running down its face. It has a slime-like substance drooling out of its fingers, with a hole in its palm.

Blob's ability is currently unknown due to its short appearance. It was mentioned that a Stand had sucked up citizens of Morioh at the school gym, which could have either been Blob or Twister.
